title: Sean Payton: Broncos have to get a handle on injuries, look at our pre-practice routine

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton: Broncos have to get a handle on injuries, look at our pre-practice routine
sources.description: "You always try to look at your pre-practice routine," Payton said. "Your hydration, obviously. And it’s incumbent on the player."
